documentTitle.description: Document title stored in the PDF metadata. When set, a visible title is rendered above the exported table. Provide a PdfCell to style the title.

pdfStyles.description: Overrides PDF colours using theme-style keys such as `backgroundColor`, `headerBackgroundColor`, and `oddRowBackgroundColor`. Values accept CSS colours.

skipStyleCallbacks.description: Set to `true` to skip `rowStyle`, `getRowStyle`, `colDef.cellStyle`, and `colDef.headerStyle` during PDF export.

currentElementStyleCallback.description: Callback used to override PDF styles for exported `row`, `cell`, `rowgroup`, `header`, and `groupheader` elements.

prependContent.description: Content to put at the top of the PDF export. A 2D array of PdfCell objects or a multi-line string that is split into rows.

appendContent.description: Content to put at the bottom of the PDF export. A 2D array of PdfCell objects or a multi-line string that is split into rows.
